title: Traveller Club Points Earn Rates on Travel Protection Plans
content:
Each Travel Protection Plans plan carries an earn rate, stated as the percentage of the premium that accrues as traveller club points.

| Plan | Points earn rate, per cent of premium |
| --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 0 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 25 |
| TripGuard Plus | 50 |
| TripGuard Premier | 75 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 100 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 75 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 100 |

Trip Basics Essential carries an earn rate of 0 and therefore accrues no points at all. Cancel For Any Reason Elite and Annual Multi-Trip Executive carry the highest rate in the range at 100 per cent, and Annual Multi-Trip Traveller carries the same 75 per cent as TripGuard Premier.
